## Behavioral tradeoffs

- **general_deployer_recovery / execution_integrity**: Eligible empty deploying haulers recover the native home target and stop abandoned thrust at release/failure/idle boundaries. Removes: Targetless idle/failed empty-haul state when eligibility passes.. Preserves: Native target choice, movement, fuel and exclusions..
- **global_prediction_invalidation / accounting_integrity**: Semantic target change clears TripFuelPrediction, not NavData. Removes: Old manual trip budget after a goal change.. Preserves: Stored route currently remains outside VORB-specific handling..
- **vorb_scope / regional_containment**: Existing VORB-only deployer target reset and invalid-plan manual fallback; shared observers own target comparison and refill accounting. Removes: Stale route and invalid supplied plan within the unchanged regional scope.. Preserves: Other home stations remain unmodified by this guard..
- **shared_replenishment / accounting_integrity**: Actual accepted RCS addition translates the still-current plan budgets across AI roles and homes before route validation. Removes: External refill erased by absolute remaining-fuel reconciliation.. Preserves: Planned expenditure, targets and native route/assistance policy; player ships are excluded..

## Dependencies not transition-expanded

- **unexpanded**: Higher-priority pilot branches, native SFF callbacks, player torch plotting and late loaded-ship fuel reconciliation require separate scopes.
- **escape_handoff**: Production escape setter uses coherent native assignment and invalidates obsolete routes for semantic goal changes. Native caller evidence: Notes/AI-RETARGET-CALLER-AUDIT.md. Complete combat/retreat is outside this slice; generic ApplyToShip route invalidation has not been generalized. Navy/Blockade already clear routes through TargetNearestStation.
- **planet_safe_avoidance**: Shared native evasion rejects past-only warnings and vets opposite dodges against bodies and moving obstacles. No target/retirement policy changes. Full flight geometry remains outside this slice; see Navigation/PLANETARY-AVOIDANCE-AUDIT.md and Tests/PlanetaryNavigationCheck.
- **station_docked_traffic**: Saved PDA policy, default on: nonstation hulls connected to stations/apartments are nonhazards while enabled; disabling immediately restores native hull treatment. Enabled hulls are nonhazards for ship contact, AI evasion and proximity scans. Free-space tows, actual stations, weapon/planet hits remain native. Shared-command fixture evidence; no geometric transition model or forced arrival.
- **shared_target_lifetime**: Permanent vessel removal, same-ID replacement and restored missing destinations are transition-expanded and natively tested in the TargetLifecycle model; no deployer-specific retargeting policy is added.

These unresolved boundaries prevent calling this an all-patches effective simulation. Native inner/outer Harmony phases and side effects must be expanded before drawing conclusions across them.
